chainlink: Chain-Linked Price and Volume Measures

Source: R/chainlink-package.R
chainlink-package.Rd

Tools to derive price and volume measures of national accounts following chapter 8 of the International Monetary Fund (2018) "Quarterly National Accounts Manual (2017 Edition)" doi:10.5089/9781475589870.069 : Laspeyres-type, Paasche-type and Fisher-type volume indices, chain-linking of quarterly or monthly volume indices with the annual overlap and the one-quarter overlap techniques, exact contributions to percent change of the chain-linked volume measures, and non-additivity of the chain-linked series. The benchmarking of the quarterly series on annual data can be done with the 'tempdisagg' package.

Details

The package follows the chapter 8 (Price and Volume Measures) of the IMF Quarterly National Accounts Manual. All the functions use ts objects (quarterly or monthly series, or annual series for the annual indices).

Main functions:

  • volume indices from current prices and price indices: cp_pi2vol(), laspeyres(), paasche(), fisher(), and the conversion of price indices with pi_py2pp(), pi_annual() and cp_pi2cy();

  • chain-linking with the annual overlap and the one-quarter overlap techniques: chain_laspeyres(), chain_link(), annual_chain(), and chain_rebase() to change the reference year;

  • contributions to percent change: chain_contrib() (chain-linked Laspeyres-type measures) and fisher_contrib() (Fisher indices);

  • non-additivity and related tools: chain_discrepancy(), chain_pseudo() (variables that change sign), chain_unchain() and chain_aggregate() (indirect seasonal adjustment of chain-linked series, following the ESS Guidelines on Seasonal Adjustment).

The benchmarking of the quarterly series on annual data is not implemented: see for instance the tempdisagg package.

See the vignettes: vignette("imf_qna_manual", package = "chainlink") (examples of the manual), vignette("contributions", package = "chainlink") and vignette("practical_case", package = "chainlink").

References

International Monetary Fund (2018), Quarterly National Accounts Manual (2017 Edition), chapter 8 "Price and Volume Measures", Washington, DC. doi:10.5089/9781475589870.069 .

Eurostat (2015), ESS Guidelines on Seasonal Adjustment (2015 Edition), Luxembourg, Publications Office of the European Union. doi:10.2785/317290 .
